name: uoai-monorepo
description: Universal Offline AI (UOAI) — Privacy-first, offline-capable local AI provider in Chromium browsers

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @uoai/shared-types && npm run build -w @uoai/api-protocol && npm run build -w @uoai/model-registry && npm run build -w @uoai/model-storage && npm run build -w @uoai/model-adapters && npm run build -w @uoai/inference-core && npm run build -w @uoai/browser-bridge && npm run build -w @uoai/sdk && npm run build -w @uoai/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @uoai/web && npm run build -w @uoai/extension && npm run build -w @uoai/demo
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:boundaries && npm run lint:static-assets && npm test && npm run test:e2e
